scope: Numerical values of published exact 1L-4L coefficient rows, evaluated from those rows. Each row keeps the more accurate of its previous numerical value and the value of its exact formula at the precision its constants allow (cap 20,000 digits), after checking that the two are compatible. Exact rows, symbolic availability and the five-loop data are unchanged; no exactness is created by this publication.
error_model: First-order estimate, not an interval proof: sum |df/dc| err_c over finite constants (published error plus one unit of the last stored digit, at least the error implied by the constant's validated digits) + sum |df/dL| radius_L over native Symbolica ball leaves + |f(W1) - f(W2)|; derivatives at 40 digits. absolute_error = this budget + half a unit of the last stored digit of the published value.
digit_rule: significant_digits = min(largest N with absolute_error < |v| 10^-N, smallest validated-digit count of the finite constants in the formula, 20000); stored_significant_digits = significant_digits + 8.
decision_rule: Replace a row only if its formula digits exceed its previous significant_digits and |new - previous| <= absolute_error(new) + error(previous) + half a unit of the previous last digit, where error(previous) is its absolute_error if recorded, else |previous| 10^-significant_digits. Ties keep the previous bytes. Exact-zero rows keep their previous bytes.

engine.arithmetic: Symbolica 3.0.0 Python evaluate (MPFR), leaf inputs exactly zero-padded to W+30 digits
engine.classical_leaves: native Symbolica SixthRootHplEvaluator / EndpointOneGplEvaluator / evaluate_tracked balls (c20k binary), computed separately at W1 and W2

validation.working_precision_agreement: every non-zero row agrees between W1 and W2 to at least 20094.7 digits
validation.leaves: all 251 HPL words agree with validation/hpl-values-20000.tsv.gz to >= 20023.35 digits; 15 GPLs agree with PARI polylogmult at 5000 digits (>= 5000.8); closed-form helper checks >= 20212 digits
validation.independent_engine: PARI/GP 2.17.3 with its own converter and HPL/GPL evaluation (no Symbolica): 64 checks on 59 rows, all passed (43 new 4L closure rows at 560 digits, worst 560.68; 14 classical rows at 2100, worst 2100.58; 7 rows at 20000, worst 20001.1)
validation.output_check: final/verify-outputs.json: 0 problems; 188 purely rational rows checked with exact fractions
validation.label: COMPUTED+VALIDATED (two working precisions 20100/20200 + PARI/GP independent engine on 59 rows); error_quality estimated

exact_rows_note: Digests of the published exact row texts whose values were evaluated. They are unchanged from the base commit; their acceptance is that of their original publications.
